standardModel.when: default for ordinary work: direct questions and explanations, quick lookups, small single-file edits, routine fixes and tweaks with clear scope

almost purely mechanical output the user asked for verbatim: committing changes and writing the commit message — including /commit or any commit command — or other short one-shot generation with no analysis or exploration needed

complexModel.when: real engineering work needing judgment: implementing features likely to span several files, debugging a failure or unexpected behavior, refactoring, reviewing changes for correctness and design
the hardest tasks in the tier: architecture design or redesign, subtle cross-cutting changes, tricky correctness or performance problems, deep analysis of a large codebase or long history
